content:
The image shows a green leaf with discrete, dark brown to black necrotic lesions scattered across its surface. The lesions are irregular in shape, some with a slightly sunken or angular appearance. No white powdery coating (ruling out Powdery Mildew), no black sooty film (ruling out Sooty Mould), and no tip/shoot dieback (ruling out Die Back). The discrete, dark, sunken spots are classic Anthracnose symptoms caused by *Colletotrichum* spp.
